name: Jorge Armando Solis Cruz
summary: Computer Systems Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with over 6 years of experience in designing, developing, and scaling enterprise web platforms (ERP, E-commerce, and SaaS). Specialized in backend architecture with PHP (Laravel) and reactive frontend with Vue.js / JavaScript. Possesses foundational knowledge in C# and .NET, relational databases (MySQL, SQL Server, SQLite), as well as experience in building custom tools, integrating payment gateways (Stripe), and Agile methodologies (SCRUM).

experiences.title: Full-Stack Developer
experiences.description: Technical leadership and full-cycle development of large-scale enterprise web platforms (ERP and E-commerce). Specialized in system architecture and implementation using Laravel and Vue.js, optimizing data persistence and business scalability.
responsibilities: Design and architecture of critical ERP modules focused on financial management, inventory, and automated reporting using PHP/Laravel and MySQL.
Led the migration and modernization of frontend interfaces using Vue 3 and component reactivity optimization.
Design, documentation, and implementation of RESTful APIs integrated with payment gateways (Stripe, webhooks) and third-party services.
Optimization of SQL queries and database design, reducing backend response times in transactional modules.
Implementation of clean architectures (Repository Pattern, Service Layers) and quality assurance through automated testing and code coverage.
Technical mentorship for junior developers and active collaboration in agile pods under the SCRUM framework.

experiences.title: Software Developer / Contributor
experiences.description: Maintenance and feature development for Open Source packages distributed via npm for the Vue.js ecosystem, along with building custom tools designed to optimize developer workflows.

education.description: Comprehensive background in software development (OOP, C#, .NET, Android Studio), relational database management (SQL Server, MySQL), and network architecture.
